title: Audit Live mobile PIN lineage wiring before browser verification
mission: Perform a repository-level audit of the Live mobile PIN lineage/detail path so browser-capable verification is not the first place wiring defects are discovered. Trace feed fields for generation, owner, collision and recovery into the rendered detail, verify static overflow/readability guards and existing regression hooks, and patch only bounded repository-local defects. Do not claim browser or Human Acceptance evidence.
definition_of_done: Trace the static Live feed fields for PIN generation, owner, collisions and recovery into gh-pages Live rendering code.
Verify index/mobile script/style contracts do not silently omit the compact PIN detail or introduce obvious page-wide overflow hazards.
Check the feed builder and any repository regression that protects this path; add a bounded regression if a source-level gap is found.
Persist exact changed paths/tests or STATIC_CONTRACT_OK evidence.
Return representative_javascript_browser as the remaining external verification boundary.
No Current, Human Accepted or Served promotion.
